fact: On 15 May 2025 Cameroon and Chad agreed that CAMTEL would finish the Yagoua-Bongor link by end June 2025, raise cross-border capacity to 100 Gbit/s and launch the Kribi-Kousseri 'Clean Corridor', on a fibre interconnection in service since 2015.
title: Le Tchad sécurise sa connectivité avec le Cameroun par un nouvel accord sur la fibre optique
